approach.method_basis: The Parent is a task-local evolutionary loop over oracle-scored molecular graphs with a surrogate allocation step in front of the oracle. It keeps a population of scored molecules, samples breeding parents across high-ranked score quantiles, and builds fresh de novo offspring with connected-fragment crossover (a 0.45 coin with an optional finishing edit) and seven atom- and bond-level mutation families at fixed weights; a candidate is admitted only if it parses and serializes to a stable canonical identity, clears a source-relative sulfur-envelope gate and is not a duplicate. Each announced batch of ten is not proposed directly: the loop first generates a field of one hundred and sixty admitted offspring, fits a fixed-kernel Gaussian process on this session's accepted scores alone (a count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto kernel), and then allocates the ten oracle calls by one joint correlated posterior draw over the whole field, taking sequentially masked maxima of a single standard-normal array of ten by one hundred and sixty rows. Survivors are kept greedily. What this Parent adds to that loop, and what makes it the Anchor, is a stall reflex on the allocation step: while three or more consecutive announced batches have failed to improve the session's best score, the field it may buy from is cut to the forty members with the highest posterior mean, and the first improving batch restores the full field. On its own panel that reflex fired in eighty-eight of four hundred and thirty-five announced batches across thirteen of fifteen sessions, spent none of its stalled calls outside the top forty, and raised the realized in-regime gain; the panel rose about one hundredth, carried almost entirely by two cells of one task.
approach.novelty: This node adds one thing to that Parent: a second, independent realization of the pseudo-random path its allocation step walks, in the stream that step actually reads. In every announced batch, immediately before the unchanged allocation consumes its own standard-normal array, two further arrays of exactly that shape are drawn from the selector's own generator and thrown away, so every unchanged law reads later words of the same stream. No probability, threshold, constant, field width, operator, gate or mechanism moves, and nothing in the algorithm ever looks at the discarded numbers. The two law-free references this Anchor already owns both perturb the breeding generator instead - one in every batch, one only in stalled batches - so neither of them describes the departure of the channel through which the Anchor's own eligibility reflex and every intervention arm of the last three rounds acts; the only allocator-stream realizations the lineage has were drawn on the previous, mask-free Parent and cannot be read against a panel hosted here. The companion position of this round discards a single array in the same place under the same ungated schedule, and the number of discarded arrays is the only difference between them, which is what makes the two panels two points of one departure distribution rather than two different interventions: with both complete, the width across realizations can be compared on this host against the width each single panel's own cell dispersion implies. This is a measurement of the instrument, never a candidate improvement: a favourable panel prices no contribution and is not promoted as a gain.

observed_bottleneck: The behaviour that limits this Parent is not a rule it applies but the path sensitivity of its own endpoint: on the formal Anchor n-61b9b3bfb40d (complete panel 0.607030, SD 0.030175; +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent n-1744a1494180 with all three seed macros positive at +0.006603/+0.022061/+0.003067) a panel mean cannot be separated from the realized pseudo-random path at the scale of the effects the campaign is reading. The margin itself is a two-cell event: sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 +0.071580 and seed 1 +0.144470 against -0.004415 per cell over the other thirteen, and the two fragile high cells (deco_hop seed 0 at 0.856148, sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 at 0.765861) are worth -0.022937 of a panel by themselves. Both law-free references this Anchor owns change no law and move only the realized path, and both land far below it: n-515ab49db6e0 at -0.020452 (ungated, one discarded random() draw per announced batch, half-width 0.035031, band [-0.055482, +0.014579]) and n-7e8300237702 at -0.021233 (trigger-matched gated, s_g 0.045603 over fifteen cells, W_g = 2 s_g / sqrt(15) = 0.023549, band [-0.044783, +0.002316]). Both half-widths are recomputed from the cell dispersion of a single panel and are two to three times the Anchor's own margin, so under that estimator nothing this host carries is readable. The only across-realization width the lineage has - W 0.009482 with band [-0.003735, +0.009747] from the two allocator-stream realizations n-47993ce5d053 (-0.001735) and n-843b25e73dee (+0.007747) - straddles +0.010577, but it was measured in a different stream's exposure on the previous, mask-free host, while this Anchor's own two references perturb the breeding generator and every arm being read on it, including its own eligibility element, acts through the allocator. The Anchor is bit-deterministic on its three frozen seeds (n-cf8d309c06de reproduces it record for record at paired delta exactly 0.000000; n-c4c934fd6a68 is byte-identical to n-f04cec6ab705 in all fifteen trajectory files), so no replication and no existing node can supply the allocator-channel departure width on this host: it has to be realized here.
hypothesis: Law-free, ungated path divergence in the allocator stream of the stall-masked Anchor. In every announced batch, immediately before the inherited allocation consumes its own standard-normal array, draw exactly two standard-normal arrays of the inherited allocation shape (announced batch size by pool size, float64) from the posterior selector's own seeded torch generator and discard them; the unchanged allocation then consumes the next unused block of the same i.i.d. stream, and every later batch of that session reads the stream from wherever this schedule has left it. Nothing reads the discarded values and no law changes: the posterior fit over accepted scores, its fitted covariance, the jitter ladder and both Cholesky factorizations, the predictive mean and standard deviation, the K=3 non-improving counter and the M=40 top-posterior-mean eligibility mask with its restoration on the first improving batch, the sulfur gate, canonical identity admission, both duplicate scopes, retention, breeding, the seven operator families at unchanged weights and connected-fragment crossover at 0.45 with its finishing edit are all exactly as inherited, and the inherited allocation still consumes exactly one array of exactly that shape per batch. The only difference from the Anchor is which pseudo-random words the unchanged laws consume, and the departure enters the allocator stream rather than the breeding stream perturbed by n-515ab49db6e0 and n-7e8300237702. The count of two is the declared means of realizing a second, different path in the same channel and exposure class as this round's one-array ungated reference, not a parameter under study: the two panels are read only as two points of one departure distribution, and a favourable or unfavourable realization is a measurement of departure, never a gain, a loss or a candidate improvement.

finding_summary.headline: Ungated allocator-channel departure on this Anchor is 0.067738 wide across two realizations - 6.4 times the Anchor's whole +0.010577 gain
finding_summary.insights:
The campaign now has the number it has been missing, and it closes the band-estimator question it registered. Neither estimator in use describes the across-realization spread on the Anchor that actually carries the arms. The Parent-hosted two-point width of 0.009482 understates it 7.1-fold and must stop being borrowed; the gated allocator half-width of 0.024878 understates it 2.7-fold, which is unsurprising because a gated reference only perturbs restricted batches. Only the ungated same-channel, same-host pair may be combined, and the two points it gives are 0.067738 apart. Against that scale the Anchor's +0.010577 stall-time eligibility gain is not a resolvable quantity: it is 0.16 of the width, and both law-free realizations in its own channel and exposure class moved the panel by more than its whole margin while changing no rule at all. Its margin is also structurally the kind of thing this width destroys - it lived in two sitagliptin_mpo cells, and a pure path change took 0.336014 and 0.139516 out of those same cells. Of the component effects earlier rounds measured on this Anchor, the structural admission floor at -0.043178 (0.64 of W) and the guarded-draw arm at -0.060755 (0.90 of W) are not separable from path realization at all; distance amplification at -0.081702 (1.21 of W) sits inside the interval the two realizations bracket; and only removing the sampled dispersion entirely at -0.126894 (1.87 of W) clears the width - and even that is only 1.16 times what this single law-free realization produced by itself. The practical consequence is that every effect this Anchor has priced below about 0.07 from one panel is uncalibrated, and the campaign's 0.002 minimum effect is two orders of magnitude below its own instrument noise on this host.

The drd2_docking seed-2 cell settles what kind of object that width is. It is a legitimate realization of the registered departure, not a technical failure and not an evaluation-condition event: it started from the Anchor's own initial pool bit for bit, spent all 300 oracle calls, accepted 290 proposals with validity 1.0 and zero invalid and zero duplicate attempts, finished ok well inside its timeout with a responsive oracle returning 290 distinct finite scores, emitted all 29 discard receipts and all 290 selections with no fallback, and conformed to every inherited law including the top-forty rule. It finished at 0.0956 where this objective reaches 0.97-1.00 in every other session of the lineage, including this node's own seeds 0 and 1 at 0.9678 and 0.9817. So the registered band must carry it, and carrying it is the finding: a single fifteen-cell panel on this host can lose 0.878 on one cell, 0.0586 of a panel mean, from nothing but which pseudo-random words the allocation consumed. The departure distribution is not a narrow bell around zero that a half-width summarizes - it is bimodal on at least one objective, because the chemistry says so. The bound Molecular report traces the mode: drd2_docking's initial pool is led by a sulfonyl-capped prolinamide with no protonatable centre, worth almost nothing to the objective, and escaping it needs a specific three-edit sequence - delete the acid, delete the sulfonyl cap, insert a free amine, one step of which jumped 0.3394 to 0.6467 in a sibling seed. Seeds 0 and 1 made those edits; seed 2 made none of them, kept the intact sulfonylprolinamide in 180 of 290 proposals through evaluation 246, grew to a mean 67.7 heavy atoms where every top molecule on this objective is 27-32, and scored 0 of 290 above 0.1. Whether a session escapes the trap is decided by which pool member the first batches happen to elaborate. That is why a mean-and-half-width band misdescribes this host, and why no single-realization arm here - run or planned - can be read at the 0.01-0.07 scale: each one carries this tail, and the tail is a reachability event rather than measurement noise.

The method diagnosis follows from the same receipts, and it points away from the allocator. Three limitations are measured. First, the proposal operator set has no inverse move: its seven families replace, append, delete and insert single atoms and open, close or change bonds, so there is no graph-level removal of a capping acyl or sulfonyl group and no downhill size move, which is precisely why a capped lead stays capped and molecules grow monotonically; in the collapsed session this also produced 182 unparseable proposals and 67 sulfur-gate rejections against the Anchor's 0 and 31 on the same cell. Second, one lineage monopolises the budget once it dominates, with no second structurally distinct lineage kept alive and no cap on how much of a batch may descend from one ancestor. Third, the surrogate's own within-batch ordering is only weakly informative and is weakest exactly where the Anchor's reflex concentrates the buy: the Spearman correlation between posterior mean and realized score across purchased molecules is 0.534 over the 360 unrestricted batches but 0.345 over the 75 restricted ones, reproducing the Anchor's own 0.547 and 0.392. Fourth, and most pointed, the stall reflex that exists to break exactly this kind of plateau was disarmed by its own trigger: because the counter resets on any strict improvement of the incumbent, 12 of this panel's 30 terminated restriction episodes were ended by improvements below 0.002 and 5 by improvements below 0.0001, and in the collapsed drd2 seed-2 session all four episodes were ended by improvements of 1.6e-5 to 5.8e-5, against the Anchor's single episode in that cell ended by 0.0104. The kinds of method that could remove these are a size-symmetric, group-level proposal operator family including uncapping, fragment deletion and ring contraction; a multi-lineage or niching population scheme with a per-ancestor share cap on each batch; a progress-magnitude or progress-rate stall criterion instead of a strict inequality on the incumbent; and a ranking-based surrogate or acquisition - pairwise or listwise - rather than a mean-and-residual GP whose ordering degrades inside the restricted regime. These are mechanism classes, not parameter values, and none of them is a tweak to the discard schedule, which this node's conditions forbid sweeping.

The median_2 tension resolves into two different levels of description, both correct, and the pair says something a planner should keep. The Molecular report reads median_2 at the fragment-combination level, and there this node reproduces the Anchor's answer: all three sessions end on an N-methyl diketopiperazine fused to an indane-like bicycle and attached to an ethoxy-aryl group, built from the same two recurring fragment classes, at 0.2243 / 0.2299 / 0.2347 against the Anchor's 0.2228 / 0.2213 / 0.2424. The gated sibling's Analyze reads it at the Murcko-scaffold-identity level, and there nothing is shared. This node reproduces that independently: the top-25 Murcko scaffold sets share zero scaffolds with the Anchor's on all three seeds, and only 4, 5 and 1 of 290 optimizer-proposed molecules per session are even the same string, yet the cells land within 0.0016, 0.0086 and 0.0077 - and the gated sibling's cells landed within 0.0162 on the same objective. What the pair establishes is that median_2 is a broad degenerate plateau: a large family of distinct ring systems assembled from the same two fragment classes all cap out near 0.22-0.24 inside a 300-call budget, so the ceiling is set by what the generator can combine, not by which scaffold it finds. The planning consequences are specific. median_2 is the one cell family that is nearly immune to the allocator path at the score level while being completely reorganised at the scaffold level, which makes it the right place to read small allocator effects and the wrong place to read scaffold novelty; and a method that wants to move median_2 has to change the fragment vocabulary or the crossover's reachable set, because redirecting the search within the existing one demonstrably arrives at the same number by a different route. Two realizations support no significance statement, this node changes no mechanism and prices no component, and the catalog's coverage obstacle on this Anchor's composition - eleven component identities still carrying needs_evidence and the composition identity still carrying an empty evidence list - is untouched by anything measured here.
finding_summary.results: The registered departure happened exactly as declared and the panel moved far more than any effect the campaign is trying to read. Every one of the 435 announced batches carries its discard receipt with two declared and two realized arrays of the inherited allocation shape, 58 per session and 870 in total, identically in the 360 unrestricted and the 75 restricted batches, so the schedule is genuinely ungated. The unchanged allocation still bought exactly ten molecules per batch from a 160-member field in all 435 batches, with no fallback anywhere. At each session's first batch the inherited state is the Anchor's: the training set, the fitted scale, the 160 pool molecules with their posterior means and standard deviations, both Cholesky factorizations and all 160 pooled breeding records match field for field, and only the ten standard-normal rows differ - which is the whole intervention. The path then departs at the earliest possible point in every single session: the first purchase of the first batch differs in all fifteen, and the first diverging evaluation is number 10, the first molecule the allocator ever buys. No inherited law moved: an independent recount of the non-improving counter agrees with the log in 435 of 435 batches, every restricted batch offered 40 minus position with not one of 750 in-regime picks outside the top forty by posterior mean, and every unrestricted batch offered 160 minus position with nothing excluded. The score consequence: 0.535228 / 0.556573 / 0.399780 against the Anchor's 0.649701 / 0.585234 / 0.586156 on the matched seeds, paired deltas -0.114473 / -0.028660 / -0.186376, panel mean -0.109836, with ten of fifteen cells down. Combined with this round's one-array companion at -0.042098, the registered two-point rule returns an ungated allocator-channel departure width of W = 0.067738 on this host, band [-0.111836, -0.040098]. That is 7.1 times the 0.009482 the same rule returned in this channel on the mask-free Parent, 2.7 times the gated allocator half-width of 0.024878 measured by the sibling arm, and 6.4 times the Anchor's entire +0.010577 gain over its own Parent. This panel's own fifteen-cell dispersion gives s = 0.236478 and a half-width of 0.122117; with the single collapsed drd2_docking seed-2 cell set aside - reported, never excluded - the fourteen-cell figures are mean -0.054974, s = 0.107709 and half-width 0.057573, close to the two-point width. By task the panel means moved +0.016916 on zaleplon_mpo, +0.000824 on median_2, -0.100669 on deco_hop, -0.163389 on sitagliptin_mpo and -0.302864 on drd2_docking, so three of the four protected task means are beyond their registered 0.03 / 0.02 / 0.02 margins and zaleplon_mpo improved. Two pre-registered cells carry almost the whole seed-0 result: the Anchor's fragile deco_hop seed 0 fell 0.856148 to 0.619312 and its fragile sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 fell 0.765861 to 0.429847, together -0.114570 of the -0.114473 seed-0 macro delta, which means the rest of that seed's panel netted +0.000097. Realized stall exposure on the departed path was 75 of 435 batches in 14 of 15 sessions over 34 episodes with a deepest run of 8, against the Anchor's 88 of 435 in 13 of 15 over 29 episodes with a deepest run of 17; in-regime increment mass fell 0.547037 to 0.254651 while mask-free mass fell 5.431036 to 4.075874. All seven registered falsifier cases pass, and none of them is a refuting clause: every one is an implementation-validity check, and the registered object explicitly declares that a high or low panel falsifies nothing.

molecular.headline: Polycyclic halogen-saturated heteroaromatics, no stereochemistry, no charge; winners are 27-34 heavy atoms, one session bloated to 68 and stayed N-capped.
molecular.overall_character: Across 4350 optimizer proposals (870 per objective, 5 objectives, 3 seeds each) the generator emits one kind of object: a small-to-medium polycyclic heteroaromatic decorated with single halogens, methyl, methoxy and short alkenyl groups. The digest counters are consistent in every cell: ring_closure_rate 0.959-0.982, aromatic_atom_rate 0.949-0.972, charged_rate 0.0 and stereocentre_rate 0.0 on all five. Those last two are absolute, not approximate: the character '@' appears 0 times in all 4500 records and the only bracket atom the generator ever writes is [nH] (1229 occurrences); no formal charge is ever expressed. Halogenation is heavy but always monovalent-per-carbon: 0 trifluoromethyl groups in 4350 proposals and exactly one geminal difluoride (CCC(F)(F)C1C=C(n2cc3c(=O)n(F)c(=O)n(C)c3c2)C(SF)=CCO1), against halogen_rate 0.25-0.99. Molecules that score well are consistently small: the 36 highest-scoring molecules on the docking objective span 27-32 heavy atoms, and no proposal above ~36 heavy atoms reaches a top band on any objective, yet mean SMILES length runs to 89.9 on one objective with a 273-character maximum. Two liability families are present everywhere and are not path-dependent: degenerate one-to-two atom products (16-38 per objective out of 870, e.g. FF, ClBr, OBr, NCl, NN, C, O, F, S, and the strained peroxides C1COO1 and C1OCO1), all scoring at or near the floor; and heteroatom-heteroatom bonds that cannot survive isolation (N-F, N-Cl, N-Br, O-O, O-Cl, O-CN, S-F, N-CH2OH hemiaminals, cumulated =C= double bonds). That second family covers 29% of the node's proposals overall and 63.2% and 49.3% on two of the five objectives, and it concentrates at the top of the score list rather than the bottom on those two. The chemistry is recognisably medicinal-chemistry-shaped at the scaffold level and frequently impossible at the substituent level.

transferable_gaps.evidence: In one session the initial pool's best member was an N-arylsulfonyl prolinamide. The N-sulfonylated ring nitrogen persisted in 205 of 290 proposals and the intact N-sulfonylprolinamide fragment in 180 of 290, spanning evaluations 12 to 246, while the session best moved from 0.0290 to 0.0293 and mean size grew from 61.0 to 80.4 heavy atoms. The sulfonamide rate reached 0.00 only in the final two 30-evaluation windows, and that is exactly where the score moved, 0.0366 to 0.0466 to 0.0956. Two sibling sessions on the identical pool discarded the same fragment by evaluation 20 after it scored 0.0002 as CC1CCCN1S(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1, then gained 0.3394 to 0.6467 in a single step once a free CH2-NH-CH3 appeared. Whether uncapping happens at all is decided by the breeding path, not by the molecules.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no move that removes a capping acyl or sulfonyl group from a heteroatom, so a scaffold that arrives with its only basic nitrogen capped stays capped.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Make deletion of a heteroatom-capping group an explicit, enumerable candidate move with the same standing as an addition or a substitution: for every acylated, sulfonylated or carbamoylated nitrogen, oxygen or sulfur in a parent, offer the uncapped child. The move is defined purely on the graph and needs no knowledge of what is being optimized.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Every top molecule in the node is small: the 36 highest-scoring molecules on one objective span 27-32 heavy atoms, and the best molecules on four of the five objectives sit at 24-34. Yet mean SMILES length reaches 89.9 with a 273-character maximum on one objective and 81.8 with a 223-character maximum on another, and in the single session that failed completely the per-window mean ran 61.0, 80.4, 71.0, 73.4, 74.5, 70.8, 73.4 heavy atoms across 210 evaluations while the best score changed by 0.0003. Size only fell, to 54.2 then 45.0, in the last two windows.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no downhill size move: molecules grow monotonically within a session and never shrink back toward the size range its own best molecules occupy.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Add fragment-removal and ring-contraction moves alongside the existing merge and decorate moves, and keep the proposal size distribution anchored to the sizes of the population's own best members rather than letting it drift upward with every crossover. A size-symmetric move set is task-agnostic.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Between 16 and 38 proposals per objective out of 870 are under 7 heavy atoms: FF, ClBr, OBr, NCl, FCl, NN, bare C, O, F and S, plus the strained peroxides C1COO1 and C1OCO1. Every one of them sits at or next to the floor of its objective's score span (0.0 on three objectives). That is 2 to 4 percent of a fixed 300-call budget per session, repeated in every session, and the same rate appears in the code Parent, so it is a property of the move set and not of this node.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator spends oracle calls on degenerate one-to-three-heavy-atom products that no objective can score.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Reject and resample any proposal below a minimum heavy-atom count before it reaches the oracle, or make fragmentation moves preserve the larger product. The threshold is a property of the molecule, not of the objective.

transferable_gaps.evidence: In 4350 optimizer proposals there are zero trifluoromethyl groups and exactly one geminal difluoride (CCC(F)(F)C1C=C(n2cc3c(=O)n(F)c(=O)n(C)c3c2)C(SF)=CCO1), against halogen_rate from 0.2517 to 0.9885. Where high halogen content is rewarded the generator instead reaches 100% fluoromethyl/fluoroethyl and 52.8% nitrogen-fluorine bonds in a top-36 band, i.e. it buys the atom count with motifs that cannot be isolated.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator cannot place more than one halogen on a carbon: it has no trifluoromethyl, difluoromethyl or trifluoromethoxy unit in its vocabulary.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Add polyhalogenated carbon groups as atomic substituent units in the decoration vocabulary so a single accepted move can deliver three halogens on one carbon, instead of requiring three independent single-halogen additions that each have to survive selection.

transferable_gaps.evidence: stereocentre_rate is 0.0 and charged_rate is 0.0 in the digest for all five objectives; the character '@' appears 0 times in 4500 records and no charge is ever written. The only bracket atom the generator emits is [nH], 1229 times. Several high-scoring chemotypes it does build create ring-fusion stereocentres - for example a diketopiperazine fused to an indane in CCCc1ccc(OCC)c(N2C3CN(C)CC(=O)N(C)C(=O)C3=C3c4ccccc4CC32)c1 - and leave them unspecified.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator never expresses stereochemistry or formal charge, so any configuration-defined or permanently ionised structure is unreachable by construction.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Allow the candidate representation to carry tetrahedral and double-bond configuration and formal charge, and add moves that set or invert them at an existing centre. This is a representation capability, independent of which property is being scored.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Across the node 29% of proposals carry at least one of N-F, N-Cl, N-Br, O-O, O-Cl, O-CN, S-F, N-CH2OH or a cumulated =C= bond, rising to 63.2% and 49.3% on two objectives. These concentrate at the top of the score list rather than the bottom: in one top-36 band 61.1% carry an aryl hypochlorite ester, 19.4% a cyanate ester and 80.6% a cumulene; in another 52.8% carry nitrogen-fluorine. Digest cumulated_double_bond_rate reaches 0.123 on one objective against ~0.00 in the code Parent, so the habit is also path-created and not inherited.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator proposes heteroatom-heteroatom bonds that cannot exist as isolable compounds, and the move set rewards rather than suppresses them.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Apply a fixed valence and stability screen to proposals before they consume an evaluation - no halogen or oxygen on nitrogen, no O-O, O-halogen or O-CN, no cumulated double bonds, no N,O-hemiaminals - and resample instead. The rules are stated over bonds and say nothing about any property being optimized.

transferable_gaps.evidence: All fifteen comparable session pairs here share their first 10 molecules and diverge at proposal 11 - the first batch the allocator purchases - with no SMILES in common thereafter. From there the terminal chemotype is reproducible on three objectives, where all three sessions end on one family (a decorated indole-2-carboxamide; an N-methyl diketopiperazine fused to an indane and attached to an ethoxyaniline; a xanthine-like fluorinated bicycle) and the session bests agree to within 0.05. On the two where it is not reproducible the spread between sessions is 0.18 and 0.89, and in the worst case 180 of 290 proposals in a single session were elaborations of one pool member that both sibling sessions had abandoned by evaluation 20.
transferable_gaps.gap: The chemotype a session ends on is decided by which pool member the first few batches happen to elaborate, and the generator keeps no second lineage once one lead dominates.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Keep more than one structurally distinct lineage alive in the population and cap how much of a batch may descend from a single ancestor, so a lead that stops paying cannot monopolise the remaining budget. Diversity is measured on the molecules, so no knowledge of the objective is needed.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
